title: Scotty3D
summary: A 3D modeling, rendering and animation package built for CMU's 15-362/662 Computer Graphics — rasterization, mesh editing, path tracing and animation.

blocks.text: Scotty3D is a 3D modeling, rendering, and animation package that students complete as part of 15-362/662 Computer Graphics at Carnegie Mellon University. The features I implemented include rasterization, mesh editing, path tracing, and animation.
